description: This file defines the ExpirationDatePickerDialogFragment class, which is a custom dialog fragment for selecting an expiration date within an Android application. It extends a branded dialog fragment, provides date selection functionality with UI theming, and allows setting or unsetting the date with callbacks for handling user actions.

classes.name: ExpirationDatePickerDialogFragment
classes.description: A dialog fragment that allows users to pick an expiration date, with branding customization and date validation features.

methods.name: setOnExpiryDateListener
methods.description: Sets the callback listener to be invoked when the user sets or unsets a date.

methods.name: onCreateDialog
methods.description: Creates and configures the date picker dialog, setting minimum date and theme.

methods.name: applyBrand
methods.description: Applies branding styles to the dialog's buttons based on the provided color.

methods.name: currentSelectionMillis
methods.description: Retrieves the currently selected date in milliseconds.

methods.name: onDateSet
methods.description: Handles the user selecting a date, invoking the callback with the selected date.

methods.name: yearMonthDayToMillis
methods.description: Converts a year, month, and day into milliseconds.
